question: In 1997 Belgian youth football moved its age cut-off from 1 August to 1 January. What happened to selected players' birth months?
options: The cluster stayed in August to October
The cluster moved to January to March
answer: The cluster moved to January to March. Before the change, boys born just after 1 August were overrepresented; after it, those born just after 1 January took their place and late-year births thinned out. Being oldest in the age group, not the season of birth, was doing the selecting. A few extra months of growth passed for talent.
move: Move the arbitrary line and see whether the advantage moves with it.
trap: Keeping the old months, as if autumn births carried some advantage.
source: Helsen et al., Am J Hum Biol, 2000
reference: Helsen, Starkes and Van Winckel, Effect of a change in selection year on success in male soccer players, American Journal of Human Biology, 2000
